surveys.title: JavaScript basics questionnaire
surveys.description: A 10-question sample test covering JavaScript syntax, data handling, and browser fundamentals.

questions.prompt: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable that can be reassigned?
questions.explanation: let creates a block-scoped binding and allows reassignment. const is block-scoped but cannot be reassigned.

questions.prompt: What does JSON.parse do with valid JSON text?
questions.explanation: JSON.parse converts valid JSON text into the equivalent JavaScript value, such as an object or array.
options: Converts it to a JavaScript value

questions.prompt: Which array method creates a new array by transforming each item?
questions.explanation: Array.prototype.map returns a new array containing the return value from each callback call.

questions.prompt: What is the result of typeof null in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: typeof null returns 'object', which is a long-standing JavaScript behavior to remember for tests.

questions.prompt: Which operator checks both value and type equality?
questions.explanation: The strict equality operator === compares values without type coercion.

questions.prompt: What does an async function return?
questions.explanation: Calling an async function always returns a Promise, even when the function returns a plain value.

questions.prompt: Which method adds an item to the end of an array?
questions.explanation: push appends one or more items to the end of an array and returns the new length.

questions.prompt: Which browser API selects the first matching element for a CSS selector?
questions.explanation: document.querySelector returns the first Element that matches the provided CSS selector.
preventDefault asks the browser not to run the event's default action, such as submitting a form normally.

questions.prompt: Which syntax creates an object literal?
questions.explanation: Curly braces with key-value pairs create an object literal, such as { name: 'Ada' }.
